objective: Combine two single-digit BCD numbers into a single packed BCD byte.
theory: The upper BCD digit is shifted left 4 times (RLC x 4) and logically ORed (ORA) with the lower BCD digit.
algorithm: 3. Store intermediate upper nibble in B.
assembly_code:
LDA 2050H   ; Load upper BCD digit (04H)
RLC         ; Shift to upper nibble (40H)
RLC
RLC
RLC
MOV B, A    ; Store in B
LDA 2051H   ; Load lower BCD digit (05H)
ORA B       ; Combine nibbles (45H)
STA 2052H   ; Store packed byte
HLT
